method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nasdaq ends 4% down, stocks slide as strong jobs data spikes chance of rate hike
Equities.reason: Major US equity-market move tied directly to macro (strong jobs -> higher odds of Fed hikes). Large headline selloff in Nasdaq is high-impact for broad risk sentiment, so strongly negative and highly relevant.

Equities.title: Strong Job Growth Weakens Stocks
Equities.reason: Same dominant macro impulse: hotter-than-expected jobs data raises policy-rate risk and undermines equities. WSJ framing confirms the market-regime narrative (good economic news -> equity risk-off).

Equities.title: Chip selloff erases over $1 trillion in stock market value
Equities.reason: Concentrated, high-impact sector shock: semiconductor rout removes substantial market cap and amplifies index volatility (Nasdaq heavy). This reinforces the risk-off, profit-taking narrative tied to rate fears and rotation away from growth.

Equities.title: Marvell to join S&P 500 after AI boom helps chipmaker pass profitability test
Equities.reason: Structural/flow story favoring tech/AI leadership: S&P inclusion (driven by AI-driven profitability) supports the long-term narrative of AI-led sector dominance and index flows into select chip names. Positive but narrower in scope than macro selloff pieces.

Equities.title: Meta's stock sinks on report company could raise tens of billions of dollars to fund AI push
Equities.summary: Meta shares dropped after the Financial Times reported the company could potentially raise tens of billions of dollars in a stock offering to help its AI push.
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic large-cap tech capital-raising story that pressures a major index component and signals investor concern about funding-intensive AI strategies. Moderately negative for tech sentiment and index performance.

Equities.title: Google to pay SpaceX $920 million a month for compute capacity at xAI data centers
Equities.summary: Ahead of a planned IPO, SpaceX inked a deal to rent compute capacity to Google for $920 million per month for 32 months.
Equities.reason: Large commercial contract highlights strong demand for AI compute and helps underpin valuations for AI-infrastructure names and SpaceX ahead of a planned IPO. Positive for AI/infra theme but limited to a subset of equities.

Equities.title: OpenAI plots biggest ChatGPT overhaul since launch
Equities.summary: $850bn start-up to recast hit chatbot as a route to higher-margin products before a potential IPO
Equities.reason: Major development in the AI ecosystem with potential implications for many listed AI and cloud-adjacent companies (product strategy ahead of IPO). Supports the persistent market theme of AI as a structural equity driver.

Equities.title: The Dow Jones Industrial Average relearns that good news is bad news
Equities.summary: There is an old reflex in equity markets that never quite dies: when the economy looks too strong, stocks get nervous. Friday brought it straight back.
Equities.reason: Narrative piece that encapsulates the prevailing market regime (strong macro data -> policy-rate fear -> equity nervousness). Useful for signaling the dominant risk-off reflex across US indices.

Rates.title: US yields rocket as stellar NFP sparks Fed hike bets
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields skyrocket across the whole curve on Friday, with the 2-year Treasury note yield rising over 12 basis points, while the benchmark note, the 10-year, surges six basis points following an outstanding Nonfarm Payrolls report.
Rates.reason: Direct market report of a broad Treasury selloff after a strong NFP. In the bond-price framework higher yields = negative for rates; this is a clear, high-relevance signal that Fed hiking odds and term premium jumped.

Rates.title: Hot jobs report puts Fed cuts further out of reach as Chair Warsh faces policy tests
Rates.summary: Another big jobs report in May has swept aside the possibility of interest rate cuts anytime soon.
Rates.reason: Interprets the strong payrolls as removing near-term cut expectations — a bearish (yields-up) read for bonds. Kept as lower relevance duplicate to the direct yields report.

Rates.title: Charting the Global Economy: Jobs, Inflation Feed Rate-Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Macro piece tying global jobs and inflation data to renewed rate-hike expectations. Reinforces a cross-market higher-for-longer narrative that puts upward pressure on global sovereign yields.

Rates.title: A Stock Trader’s Guide to the Start of ECB Interest Rate Hikes
Rates.reason: Signals the start of ECB tightening; relevant for euro-area rates and the global rates backdrop. Negative for bond prices as it increases regional yield expectations.

Rates.title: Japan: Wage gains bolster BoJ hike case – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts underscore that stronger Japanese wage data and resilient household spending are reinforcing expectations for Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening. Real and nominal wages are rising at the fastest pace since 2024, with futures pricing a high p
Rates.reason: Domestic data-driven increase in BoJ hike expectations points to higher JGB yields and tighter global rate conditions — negative for bond prices, moderate relevance as it's regional but meaningful for carry and term premia.

Rates.title: Citigroup Economists Maintain Lonely Call for Fed Rate Cuts
Rates.reason: Highlights that the consensus is moving away from cuts and one major house still expects cuts. The dominant market inference is fewer cuts, which is modestly negative for bonds; lower relevance as it's an outlier view.

Rates.title: Fed's Hammack says holding interest rates steady remains reasonable
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that it remains reasonable to keep interest rates steady for now, but she warned that if recent economic trends continue, policymakers may soon need to take action to address persistently
Rates.reason: Fed official signalling a current pause but conditional on incoming data — marginally negative for bonds because of the warning that further tightening may be needed if data stay strong; moderate relevance as it is nuanced guidance rather than immediate market-moving action.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US Dollar ends week higher after strong NFP
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) rallied to near 100.10 on Friday, rising from a daily low of 99.16, after the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report showed the economy added 172K jobs in May, well above the 85K expected, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) c
FX.reason: Strong NFP printed materially stronger-than-expected payrolls, driving DXY higher. This is a broad USD-strength narrative that pressures major USD pairs and dominates FX flows; high relevance to near-term FX direction and Fed expectations.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar falls despite solid jobs data as US NFP beat forecasts
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair rises and trades near the 1.3930 region on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground following a stronger-than-expected Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report, offsetting support from an equally impressive Canadian employment release.
FX.reason: USD bid after NFP outweighed strong Canadian jobs, pushing USD/CAD higher. Clear USD-dominant FX transmission; medium relevance for CAD flows and cross-border positioning.

FX.title: British Pound breaks below 1.3400 as blowout NFP ignites US Dollar rally
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) falls below the 1.3400 figure on Friday, registering losses of 0.37% against the US Dollar (USD) after the latest Nonfarm Payrolls report in the US crushed estimates, backing the narrative that the economy may be close to full employme
FX.reason: GBP weakened directly into the USD rally after the strong US payrolls print. Story is a direct FX pair reaction to USD strength — medium relevance for GBP/USD moves and BoE/UK positioning.

FX.title: Swiss Franc falls as US Dollar gains on stronger-than-expected NFP report
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) weakens on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) outperforms its major peers following upbeat US labor market data. At the time of writing, USD/CHF is trading around 0.7955, climbing to a two-month high.
FX.reason: CHF sold into broad USD strength after NFP, lifting USD/CHF to multi-week highs. Relevant as part of the cross-map showing USD-led moves across majors.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar heads for 3% weekly loss as robust US payrolls data lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: NZD/USD slips to its lowest level since April on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) receives fresh bids in the wake of solid US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 0.5800 and is heading for a weekly loss of nearly 3%.
FX.reason: NZD underperformed sharply as USD strength from the NFP created outsized weekly losses. High relevance for antipodean FX and cross-asset positioning given scale of move.

FX.title: Asia FX: KRW and IDR face technical strain – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong says softer Oil prices offer only limited relief to Asia FX, with the Korean Won and Indonesian Rupiah still pressured by equity outflows and policy concerns.
FX.reason: OCBC flags technical/flow stress in KRW and IDR from equity outflows and policy worries — a localized EM-Asia stress theme that exacerbates USD bid vs these currencies.

FX.title: South Korean Won: Semiconductor pullback weighs on KRW – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research’s Chang Wei Liang highlights that USD/KRW has pushed above 1530 as weakness in semiconductor stocks adds pressure on the Korean Won.
FX.reason: Sector-specific equity weakness (semiconductors) is cited as a material driver of KRW weakness and USD/KRW move above 1530 — relevant for Korea-specific FX risk but narrower in scope.

FX.title: EM FX: Indonesia and Korea under pressure – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Bob Savage underscores renewed stress in parts of EM Asia, with Indonesia’s Rupiah weakening beyond 18,000 and Korean Won pressured despite a strong current account surplus.
FX.reason: BNY highlights renewed stress across Indonesia and Korea — reinforces regional EM FX weakness narrative and complements USD-led risk/flow story.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Gradual appreciation expected versus Dollar – Nordea
FX.summary: Nordea’s Kristian Nummelin highlights that the Chinese yuan has been the best-performing Asian currency this year, appreciating against both the Dollar and the Euro despite widening US–China yield spreads.
FX.reason: Nordea expects gradual CNY appreciation vs USD, a counterpoint to the broader USD-strength theme and important for EMFX allocation and CNH/CNY flow dynamics.

FX.title: Singapore Dollar: Firm NEER with mild upside against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong expects the Singapore Dollar (SGD) Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) to trade 1.5–2% above midpoint, supported by de-dollarisation and safe-haven flows, even as reduced carry tempers its appeal.
FX.reason: OCBC sees mild SGD upside and firm NEER supported by structural flows (de-dollarisation, safe-haven demand). Modestly positive for SGD vs USD but lower relevance than major USD-driven headlines.

FX.title: Euro area: Growth forecasts face modest downgrades – Nomura
FX.summary: Nomura analysts expects the European Central Bank's (ECB) June macroeconomic projections to incorporate higher market rate assumptions and exclude May Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICP) data.
FX.reason: Nomura flags ECB projections embedding higher market rate assumptions — mild potential support for EUR via higher nominal rate expectations, but the signal is modest and secondary to USD-led moves.

FX.title: United Kingdom: Gradual EU reset shapes growth outlook – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank argues that closer EU–UK ties under Prime Minister Starmer will proceed through targeted, technical agreements that only marginally improve the United Kingdom’s growth outlook.
FX.reason: Rabobank sees only marginal growth upside from an EU–UK reset — a small supportive macro backdrop for GBP but limited near-term FX transmission versus dominant USD/NFP story.

Commodities.title: Gold melts down as blowout NFP sends DXY above 100
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price collapses during the North American session on Friday as the latest Nonfarm Payrolls report in the US smashed forecasts, with figures for the last three months upwardly revised, increasing the chance of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.
Commodities.reason: Blowout US NFP lifted DXY and fed-hike odds; direct, high‑signal negative for gold (higher rates/USD pressure). This is a clear market-moving macro driver for precious metals.

Commodities.title: China’s PBOC Adds Gold Again as Bullion Remains Under Pressure
Commodities.reason: Central-bank buying is a direct demand-supportive signal for bullion. It partially offsets USD/yield-driven weakness but is smaller in market impact than the US macro impulse.

Commodities.title: Silver tumbles below $69 as strong US jobs report boosts the US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) falls on Friday and trades around $68.90 at the time of writing, down 6.74% on the day. The white metal is under heavy selling pressure after a stronger-than-expected US employment report boosted the US Dollar and reinforced expectations of a
Commodities.reason: Same strong US-jobs / DXY / higher-rate narrative hitting silver—large downside move and high signal for the silver market.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG crashes toward 200-day SMA, eyes $61.00
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) price tanks and challenges the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) near $67.79 on Friday, as the white metal registers a daily loss of nearly 8% and is poised to end the week down by almost 10%, amid a stronger-than-expected US Nonfarm Payroll
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece tied to the same NFP-driven selloff. Tactical signal for traders; per rules, lower relevance for technical-only coverage.

Commodities.title: Electrum-Backed Mexican Silver Miner Sinda Files for US IPO
Commodities.reason: Mining-sector financing/IPO shows investor interest in silver-equity exposure; modest positive for sector sentiment but limited direct impact on physical silver balances.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas storage capacity increased slightly in 2025
Commodities.summary: Underground working natural gas storage capacity in the Lower 48 states increased slightly in 2025, according to our latest data, with growth concentrated in the South Central and Mountain regions. Underground natural gas storage provides a source of energy wh
Commodities.reason: Incremental increase in storage capacity is a small supply-side dampener for natural-gas price volatility; limited market impact on its own.

Commodities.title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027
Commodities.summary: We forecast natural gas consumption by the U.S. electric power sector this summer will remain near recent highs and set a record next summer in our May Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO). Despite a 2% increase in overall U.S. electricity demand this summer, we e
Commodities.reason: EIA forecast of sustained/high power-sector gas demand and record consumption in 2027 is supportive for natural-gas fundamentals and price upside over the medium term.

Commodities.title: Iran's threats against this Red Sea choke point are a big vulnerability for the oil market
Commodities.summary: Oil prices would spike if Iran's Houthi allies started attacking ships passing through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risk to key shipping chokepoint raises oil risk premium and near-term upside for crude prices — direct supply-risk narrative for commodities.

Commodities.title: As Oil Prices Spike, Talk of ‘Demand Destruction’ Sets In
Commodities.reason: Reports of spiking oil and market debate about demand destruction indicate elevated price levels and macro feedback risks. Net near-term bias is price-supportive but highlights downside risk.

Commodities.title: Expensive oil is making electric vehicles look positively cheap
Commodities.summary: Petrol retails for £1.58 a litre in the UK, up about 20% since the start of the year
Commodities.reason: High fuel prices are both a short-term driver of consumer pain and a structural catalyst for EV adoption; supports sustained oil demand shifts and price resilience.

Commodities.title: U.S. confirms second Texas screwworm case, Canada restricts livestock imports
Commodities.summary: New World screwworm larvae feed on the living tissue of warm-blooded animals, creating severe wounds that can be fatal if left untreated.
Commodities.reason: Animal-disease outbreak and cross-border livestock restrictions can tighten cattle supplies and are a direct positive for live‑cattle and feeder‑cattle commodity prices.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is cratering, but a new Wall Street crypto hype is on the rise
Crypto.summary: As bitcoin dropped to its lowest price since 2024, investors flock to a new type of crypto investment linked to the hyperliquid platforms, HYPE ETFs.
Crypto.reason: Major bitcoin price decline and investor flows into alternate crypto products indicate weakened BTC risk appetite and higher liquidation risk — clear negative for crypto market sentiment and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether eye worst weekly rout since FTX collapse as cryptos shed $390 billion
Crypto.reason: System-wide large cap crypto rout and massive market cap loss is a high-relevance negative signal for market liquidity, leverage unwind and risk-off dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin back above $61,000 after rout leads to $1.6 billion liquidations
Crypto.reason: Large forced liquidations highlight deleveraging and short-term volatility; still negative for near-term price action though shows some temporary stabilization.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin climbs above $62,000 as crypto market steadies after brutal selloff
Crypto.reason: Price recovery above key levels suggests short-term stabilisation and potential capitulation low — a modest positive counter-signal to the broader selloff.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin loses $60,000, falls to weakest price since October 2024
Crypto.reason: Fresh multi-month lows for BTC reinforce a negative regime shift in price discovery and pressure on correlated crypto assets and leveraged positions.

Crypto.title: BlackRock-backed tokenization firm Securitize clears key hurdle to go public on NYSE
Crypto.reason: Clear progress toward a US-listed tokenization firm backed by a major asset manager is a meaningful institutional/adoption positive for crypto infrastructure and regulatory normalization.

Crypto.title: Meta is paying creators in Stablecoins. Spending them is someone else's problem
Crypto.reason: Large tech platform adopting stablecoins for payments is an adoption/use-case positive, supporting on-chain utility even if secondary frictions exist.

Crypto.title: AI exposed a massive flaw in top crypto network and experts warn banks could be next
Crypto.reason: Security vulnerability amplified by AI raises systemic risk concerns and could undermine confidence in smart-contract safety and institutional on‑ramps — negative for market trust.

Crypto.title: Arthur Hayes dumps zcash holdings after Orchard Pool vulnerability revealed
Crypto.reason: High-profile sell-off of a privacy coin following a protocol vulnerability underscores contagion risk across altcoins and contributes to risk-off flows.

Crypto.title: U.S. House tax committee weighs crypto bills, including relief for small transactions
Crypto.reason: Legislative consideration of crypto tax relief could reduce frictions for retail activity and is a modestly positive regulatory development for adoption.
